verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document fraud, liability-shift, or chargeback/dispute rules for agent-initiated transactions, and nothing says whether the merchant, agent, or Stripe bears the risk. The nearby material covers related but different topics: SPT usage limits and revocation, network-token programs, per-transaction human approval in Link, refunds through the standard API, and marketplace-facilitator tax obligations. Under the partial-credit rules these adjacent controls earn no credit toward a documented risk-allocation policy.
